title: JANUS: Synthesizing Cross-Layer Defenses Against Web Deserialization Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2610.35532v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unsafe deserialization turns untrusted data into attacker-controlled execution, and a single vulnerability can admit diverse exploit variants that evade defenses tailored to a known exploit. Existing defenses typically operate at a single enforcement point with limited visibility into the full attack. Combining controls across layers offers complementary protection, but coordinating them to preserve legitimate functionality and adapting them to new variants requires substantial expert effort.   We propose JANUS, a red-blue adversarial framework for automated cross-layer defense synthesis. Starting from a known exploit, \sys iteratively refines deployment-specific policies in an isolated offline environment. A black-box attacker probes the current policy for exploit variants using only externally observable feedback. translated_title: JANUS：针对Web反序列化攻击的跨层防御自动合成方法
translated_abstract: 不安全的反序列化会将不受信任的数据转化为攻击者可控的执行，而单个漏洞可能允许多种攻击变体，从而绕过针对已知攻击定制的防御。现有防御通常在单一执行点运行，对完整攻击的可见性有限。跨层组合防御控制可以提供互补保护，但协调这些控制以保留合法功能并适应新的攻击变体需要大量的专家投入。我们提出了JANUS，一个用于自动化跨层防御合成的红蓝对抗框架。从已知攻击出发，JANUS在隔离的离线环境中迭代地细化特定于部署的防御策略。黑盒攻击者仅使用外部可观察的反馈来探测当前策略下的攻击变体。防御者将每个已验证的变体总结为其安全相关的影响，并使用反事实重放来分离（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: JANUS提出了一种红蓝对抗框架，通过黑盒攻击者迭代探测攻击变体与防御者进行反事实分析并细化策略，实现针对Web反序列化攻击的跨层防御自动化合成。
en_tdlr: JANUS is a red-blue adversarial framework that automatically synthesizes cross-layer defenses against web deserialization attacks by having a black-box attacker iteratively probe exploit variants while the defender refines policies through counterfactual replay and security-relevant summarization.
